label: team_0020_system_01
text: Ro-to-to-to-to... ♪

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_01
text: Cassiopeia here.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_02
text: I see you’re getting close to one of Team\nStar’s bases.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_03
text: I take it this means you’ve decided to join\nmy operation?[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_select_01
text: That’s right

label: team_0020_select_02
text: I guess so

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_04
text: Thank you.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_05
text: With this, you’re officially a member of\nOperation Starfall![VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_nelke_01
text: Hold on a second![VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: team_0020_nelke_02
text: Does this “Operation Starfall” of yours have\nroom for one more member?[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_06
text: Wha—? Who are you?![VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_nelke_03
text: The name’s Clive.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_07
text: Oh? And how long have you been spying on us?[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_nelke_04
text: No need to get your hackles raised.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0020_nelke_05
text: I’m a pal of our mutual friend here. Isn’t that\nright, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0020_select_03
text: I guess...maybe?

label: team_0020_select_04
text: We’re not pals!

label: team_0020_nelke_06
text: Ahaha! Shy as ever, I see![VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_08
text: We’re talking about going up against Team Star\nhere. It’s not something you can join in for fun.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_nelke_07
text: I’m well aware. I just need to sort out some...\nunsettled business with Team Star, that’s all.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0020_nelke_08
text: Besides, I tend to get the job done well. Not\nthat you can take my word for it, but it’s true.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_09
text: ... ... ...\c\nI suppose I’m hardly in a position to refuse help.\nWelcome to the operation, Clive.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_nelke_09
text: Great. That settles it, then.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0020_nelke_10
text: I think I heard your name earlier... Cassiopeia,\nwas it? Who exactly are you?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_10
text: Team Star and I...share some history. That’s all I’ll\nsay for now.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_nelke_11
text: I see. In that case, I won’t press you further.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_11
text: Good. Now, back to business—let’s talk\nOperation Starfall.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_nelke_12
text: Yes. What would you have us do?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_12
text: Simply put, I want you to raid each one of\nTeam Star’s bases.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_13
text: Then you’ll defeat the bosses of the team...and\nput an end to their rule![VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_nelke_13
text: “Put an end to their rule”...? You mean we need\nto oust these bosses from their roles somehow?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_14
text: That’s right. Team Star is made up of five squads,\nand each of those squads has its own base.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_15
text: You should be able to see the front gates of one\nof those bases now, in fact.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_nelke_14
text: Ah, yes...I can see them over there.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_16
text: On the other side of those is the base proper.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_17
text: And somewhere within that base lies one of your\ntargets: a squad boss.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_nelke_15
text: OK. I’m starting to get the idea.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_18
text: Well, that’s just the outline. The key to the whole\noperation is the code that the team has to follow.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_19
text: If someone challenges one of the squad bosses\nto a battle, they have no choice but to accept.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_20
text: And what’s more, if they just so happen to lose\nthat battle...\c\nthey must forfeit their role as boss altogether![VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_21
text: I went ahead and issued challenges to each base\nunder your name, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].\c\nThey’re basically declarations of war.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_22
text: Now all of Team Star knows that we’re looking\nfor a fight.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_nelke_16
text: So let’s say we defeat all the bosses and they\nstep down from their roles... What happens next?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_23
text: [EMPTY 66]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_24
text: The rest of the team crumbles with no one left to\nlead them. That’s what happens.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_nelke_17
text: [EMPTY 66]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_25
text: It’s a solid plan, but not without wrinkles.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_26
text: Each base has a bunch of Pokémon inside to\nfend off intruders, and the bases themselves are\r\na considerable size.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_27
text: Your garden-variety Trainer would be overrun\nlong before they’d get anywhere near the boss.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_28
text: That’s why your skills are essential to this\noperation, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_29
text: [EMPTY 66]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_30
text: [EMPTY 66]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_31
text: Defeat the Pokémon inside the base, and drag\nthe boss out from where they’re hiding.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_32
text: First things first, though—you’ll need to deal with\nany grunts that might be guarding the front gates.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_nelke_18
text: And what will you be doing in the meantime?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_33
text: Like I said before, I have a history with Team Star.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_34
text: That means I can’t operate out in the open.\nI’ll back you up from afar.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_nelke_19
text: All right. And what will my role be?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_35
text: Sorry, but I don’t trust you completely just yet...\c\nFor now, I’d like you to monitor the bases and\nact as [VAR 0x0100(0000)]’s support.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_nelke_20
text: You’re a cautious one, all right... I respect that.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0020_cassiopeia_36
text: I’ll be in touch again when the plan advances to\nthe next stage. Good hunting out there.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0020_nelke_21
text: Welp. Go get ’em, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0020_select_05
text: Director Clavell...?

label: team_0020_select_06
text: You look familiar...

label: team_0020_nelke_22
text: I have no idea what you mean. But if anyone asks\nyou about me, remember this...[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0020_nelke_23
text: I’m Clive, a normal academy student just like you.\nNothing more, nothing less.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
